preconditions: Explicit ordinary local Git repository and branch, tag, HEAD or full commit ID; trusted system Git supporting --no-lazy-fetch.
steps: Read commit-bound raw files through real temporary Git objects; compare exact bytes and identities while preserving branch, index, working tree and foreign files.
Exercise inert hooks/pager/filters, ignored inherited Git redirection, fixed refs, raw binary/Unicode, missing and corrupted objects, nested projects and unsafe paths.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein Vergleich oder Merge gegen einen Git-Ref MUSS dessen SpecRoad-Dateien über feste, shellfreie Git-Plumbing-Aufrufe lesen, ohne Hooks, Pager, externe Diff-/Filterprozesse, Checkout, Branch-, Index- oder Arbeitsbaumänderung.
oracle.scope: 8.i.W adds an explicitly constructed GitObjectSource using fixed shell-free rev-parse, ls-tree and cat-file operations. The adapter pins one commit, checks commit/tree/blob object hashes and binds tree-listing paths to raw verified tree bytes. It returns raw regular blobs without working-tree fallback, filters, hooks, pager, lazy fetch, replacement objects or writes. Git environment redirection/tracing and global/system configuration are excluded. Ordinary local .git stores are required; linked/indirect/special storage, symlink/gitlink resources and nested project reads are rejected. Independent actual-object fixtures preserve arbitrary index bytes, HEAD/refs, dirty/untracked/foreign files and verify exact raw bytes. R/C adversarial completion, shared project-source resolution, CLI/Work integration, linked-worktree/alternate support, scalable resource handling and supported-platform acceptance remain open. No model validation, release approval or write authority is claimed.
